## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass: `python -m unittest discover -s tests` (and the code compiles on Python 3.10)
- [ ] Added or updated tests for the change
- [ ] Works with any provider (no single-vendor tool without a fallback path)
- [ ] Never submits, sends or contacts anyone; never invents facts, people or links
- [ ] No personal data (profiles, logs, screenshots of a real workspace) in the diff
- [ ] README updated if users see a difference
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`)
